verdict.rationale: Floot's only programmatic surface is a remote MCP server with OAuth2 authentication. It is meant to be driven from interactive AI chat and IDE clients, and that belongs to the separate MCP-server story. The pack documents no CLI, no REST/OpenAPI API, no CI tokens and no headless or pipeline execution mode, and secrets must be entered through a browser dialog.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
